description: Get the full nutrient profile for one food by FDC ID. Returns all available nutrients (or a filtered subset via the nutrients[] param) with optional per-portion scaling. Use usda_search_foods to discover FDC IDs. Values are per 100 g (basisUnit "g"), except Branded foods FDC reports per 100 ml (basisUnit "ml") or per 100 of a label unit that fixes neither (basisUnit absent, basis unverified). Provide unit, optionally with quantity, to scale all nutrient values from that basis to that amount (e.g. quantity=200, unit="g" → per-200g values); a mass unit is applied to an ml or label-unit basis without conversion, and a notice says so. quantity defaults to 100 for g, oz, lb, and kg and to 1 for serving. Serving uses the valid portion FDC displays first (lowest sequenceNumber), or a positive finite Branded label size in g/GRM/GM (case-insensitive) when no portion exists; quantity multiplies that weight. A label in any other unit sets the basis rather than a serving weight, so it requires an explicit mass-unit request. quantity without unit is rejected. Narrow nutrients[] to specific IDs to reduce response size for focused queries. Set provenance=true to add to each nutrient how FDC obtained its value (derivation code, description, and source), its sample count (dataPoints), and the sample min, max, and median scaled with amount, each only where FDC sends it.

fdcId.description: FDC ID of the food. Use usda_search_foods to discover IDs.

nutrients.description: Filter to specific nutrient IDs (e.g. [1003, 1004, 1005, 1008] for protein, fat, carbs, energy). Use usda_list_nutrients to look up IDs. Omit to return all available nutrients. Requested IDs the food does not report are listed in missingNutrients.

provenance.description: Add to each nutrient what FDC records about its value: derivation (code, description, source), dataPoints (sample count), and min, max, median (sample spread, scaled with amount). Each is present only where FDC sends it: Survey (FNDDS) foods send none, Branded foods only a derivation. Off by default; it makes the response two to three times as large.

quantity.description: Amount of food, in unit, to scale nutrient values to. Must be positive. Requires unit. Defaults to 100 when unit is g, oz, lb, or kg, and to 1 when unit is "serving". Omit both quantity and unit for the per-100 values FDC reports (per 100 g, or per 100 ml when basisUnit is "ml").

unit.description: Unit for quantity. "serving" uses the weight of the valid portion FDC displays first (lowest sequenceNumber), or a Branded label size in g/GRM/GM (case-insensitive) when no portion exists, multiplied by quantity. Required when quantity is provided. Given alone, scales to 100 g, oz, lb, or kg, or to 1 serving.

name: usda_get_food

allPortions.description: All named portions for this food, in FDC's display order: ascending sequenceNumber, ties as FDC lists them, unnumbered portions last.

items.description: A named portion for this food.

amount.description: How many of the described unit gramWeight covers (0.5 for "0.5 cup"), when FDC sends one. Absent for Survey (FNDDS) portions, whose description carries the amount.

basisUnit.description: What the per-100 nutrient values are measured in: "g" for every non-Branded food and for Branded labels in g/GRM/GM, "ml" for Branded labels in ml/MLT. Absent when the label unit (e.g. IU, MG) fixes neither, so the basis is unverified.

dataType.description: FDC data source: SR Legacy, Foundation, Survey (FNDDS), or Branded.

description.description: Full USDA food name (e.g. "Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, raw").

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The FDC ID does not exist in the database. `quantity_without_unit`: quantity is provided but unit is omitted. `no_portion_data`: unit="serving" was requested but the food has no valid portion or supported Branded gram-label serving. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: FDC did not answer within the call's 45-second budget, across every attempt. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

foodCategory.description: USDA food category (e.g. "Poultry Products"): the food category for SR Legacy and Foundation, the label category for Branded, the WWEIA category for Survey (FNDDS). Absent when FDC reports none.

gtinUpc.description: GTIN/UPC barcode as FDC stores it, leading zeros kept (e.g. "011110044174"). Branded items only.

householdServingFullText.description: Serving as the label words it (e.g. "1 cup"). Branded items only.

ingredients.description: Ingredient list from label. Branded items only.

missingNutrients.description: Requested nutrient IDs this food's profile does not report, deduplicated, in request order. Absent when nutrients[] was omitted or every requested ID is present.

notice.description: Basis caveat when a food not reported per 100 g is scaled: the resolved amount was applied to its per-100 ml or unverified label-unit basis without conversion.

nutrients.description: Nutrient values for this food, per 100 of basisUnit or scaled to the scaledTo basis.

items.description: A single nutrient entry with ID, name, amount, and unit.

amount.description: Nutrient amount — per 100 of basisUnit, or per scaledTo.gramWeight when unit is provided.

dataPoints.description: Number of samples behind the value, as FDC sends it; with provenance=true only. SR Legacy sends it on every value (0 for calculated and assumed values), Foundation on analytical values; Branded and Survey (FNDDS) send none. A count, never scaled.

derivation.description: How FDC obtained the value; with provenance=true only. Foundation and Branded send one on every value, SR Legacy on some (a measured SR Legacy value can carry only dataPoints), Survey (FNDDS) on none. Absent when FDC sends none, never inferred. Code "Z" is an assumed zero, not a measurement.

description.description: What the code means, as FDC words it (e.g. "Analytical", "Calculated", "Summed").

source.description: Source category FDC files the derivation under (e.g. "Analytical or derived from analytical", "Calculated or imputed", "Assumed zero"). Absent when FDC sends none.

max.description: Highest sample value, in the same unit and basis as amount and scaled with it; with provenance=true only. Foundation sends it on most values, SR Legacy on some; Branded and Survey (FNDDS) send none.

median.description: Median sample value, in the same unit and basis as amount and scaled with it; with provenance=true only. Foundation sends it on most values; SR Legacy, Branded, and Survey (FNDDS) send none.

min.description: Lowest sample value, in the same unit and basis as amount and scaled with it; with provenance=true only. Foundation sends it on most values, SR Legacy on some; Branded and Survey (FNDDS) send none.

percentDailyValue.description: Percent daily value from product label. Branded items only.

publicationDate.description: Date this food entry was published in FDC, as YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. "2019-04-01"). A date FDC sends in another form is returned as sent.

scaledTo.description: Scaling basis when unit was provided. Absent when returning per-100 values.

gramWeight.description: Amount resolved from quantity and unit (for serving, quantity × servingInfo.gramWeight); all nutrient values are per this many grams. With basisUnit "ml" it is applied as millilitres, and with no basisUnit as label units, without conversion.

quantity.description: Quantity applied — the requested value, or the default for unit (100 for g, oz, lb, kg; 1 for serving).

unit.description: Unit provided in the request (g, oz, lb, kg, or serving).

servingInfo.description: The portion one serving weighs: the first of allPortions (the one FDC displays first), or, when the food has no portion, a Branded gram-label serving identified in its description.

amount.description: How many of the described unit gramWeight covers (0.5 for "0.5 cup"), when FDC sends one. Absent for Survey (FNDDS) portions, whose description carries the amount, and for a label serving.

description.description: Portion description: the Survey (FNDDS) portion text, or the amount, measure unit, and modifier (e.g. "0.5 cup"); for a Branded gram label, "Label serving:" with its size, unit, and household text.

servingSize.description: Serving size from the product label, in servingSizeUnit. Branded items only.

servingSizeUnit.description: Unit for servingSize as FDC reports it (e.g. "GRM", "MLT", "IU"); it sets basisUnit. Branded items only.

title: Get USDA Food
